# Technical

This section explains **how TacMap calculations and systems work** — formulas, logic flow, elevation sampling, routing cost paths, storage/decrypt, and sensors. For soldier “tap this” steps, use the **Field Guide**.

## What belongs here

| Topic | Page |
| --- | --- |
| Bearing, resection, live course | [Navigation calculations](#/navigation-calculations) |
| Path clearance sampling & arc | [Path Clearance](#/path-clearance) |
| Which routes can bill ArcGIS | [Navigation & ArcGIS Billing](#/navigation-and-arcgis-billing) |
| Encrypted map paths | [Storage Paths & Decryption](#/storage-paths-and-decryption) |
| Gyro / inclinometer | [Gyro Testing Guide](#/gyro-testing-guide) |

## Quick visual — navigation logic

![Navigation calculation logic](/media/diagrams/navigation-logic.svg)

**Invariant:** destination is fixed. While you walk, TacMap asks “what bearing from *here* reaches that pin?” It does **not** lock the first azimuth forever (unless you chose a fixed A→B start).

## Quick visual — path clearance

![Path clearance calculation](/media/diagrams/path-clearance-formula.svg)

Sample DEM along A→B → find `g_peak` → `z_peak = g_peak + C` → fit clearance arc → optional projectile animation. Terrain visualisation only — not fire control.

## How to read these docs

1. Start with the diagram.
2. Read the **Logic** steps (what the code decides).
3. Use the formula block when you need the exact computation.
4. Jump to Field Guide when you only need operator steps.
